name: CheckResultSet
message: Always check the return of one of the navigation method (next,previous,first,last) of a ResultSet.
suppress:
self::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'next'][parent::DoStatement]
  [let $name := string(*[1][self::VariableAccess]/@Name)
   return $name != '' and exists(../preceding-sibling::IfStatement
     [*[1][self::UnaryExpression[@Operator = '!']
           [MethodCall[@MethodName = 'next'][*[1][self::VariableAccess][@Name = $name]]]]]
     [*[2][self::ReturnStatement or self::ThrowStatement or self::ContinueStatement or self::BreakStatement
           or self::Block/*[last()][self::ReturnStatement or self::ThrowStatement or self::ContinueStatement
                                    or self::BreakStatement]]])]
